models_evaluated: self-completed keratinocyte cancer risk prediction tool
unlisted_practices: Using a self-completed risk prediction tool to stratify patients and guide chemoprophylaxis discussions and interventions in skin cancer screening

screen.reason: The study evaluates the real-world implementation of a clinical risk prediction tool (self-completed by patients in a walk-in clinic) to correlate predicted risk tiers with dermatologist interventions and healthcare costs, but does not test a specific safeguard or deployment practice comparative intervention.
